title: Security Deposits Basis and the Electric Service by Rate Schedule Reconnect Fee — Credit Policy Clause
content:
**Clause.** When an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is reconnected after a nonpayment disconnection, the basis on which the account's Security Deposits record was assessed may add a deposit basis surcharge to the reconnect fee:

| Assessment basis of the account's security deposit | Surcharge added to the reconnect fee |
|---|---|
| Reconnect after nonpayment | $10.00 |
| Waiver reinstatement | $20.00 |
| Any other basis, or no security deposit record | Nothing |

The surcharge is added to the crew charge in the reconnect fee, and the total is rounded to the cent.

### Hypothetical cases

| Deposit record of the service account | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| Assessed on the basis reconnect after nonpayment | $10.00 |
| Assessed on the basis waiver reinstatement | $20.00 |
| Assessed on the basis of a new service application | Nothing |

### Point of reading

- The basis is read from the security deposit record of the same service account, as recorded when the deposit was assessed.
